description: This file contains C source code for handling writing and fixing a custom header (wrgg03_header) in MTD (Memory Technology Device) flash memory devices. It includes functions for computing MD5 checksums, fixing headers, and writing data to specific offsets in flash memory, with safety checks and device operations.

methods.name: uint32_t le32_to_cpu(uint8_t * buf)
methods.description: Converts a 4-byte little-endian byte array to a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: int wrgg_fix_md5(struct wrgg03_header * shdr,int fd,size_t data_offset,size_t data_size)
methods.description: Calculates and updates the MD5 checksum in the WRGG header after fixing or verifying the data integrity.

methods.name: int mtd_fixwrgg(const char * mtd,size_t offset,size_t data_size)
methods.description: Main function to locate, verify, fix, and write the WRGG header and associated data in an MTD device.
